text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Adelaide Street West and on Charlotte Street, City Council approval of this report is required. The Hi-Rise Group is constructing a 58-storey condominium building at 355 Adelaide Street West. The site is located on the southwest corner of Adelaide Street West and Charlotte Street. Transportation Services is seeking authorization to temporarily close the eastbound curb lane on the south side of Adelaide Street West for a period of 24 months, from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028. The temporary closure of the eastbound curb lane is required to facilitate construction staging operations associated with the below grade and above grade phases of the development. City Council authorize the closure the eastbound curb lane on the south side of Adelaide Street West, between Charlotte Street and a point 50 metres west, from January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2028, inclusive. 2. City Council rescind the existing standing prohibition in effect 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. Friday, through Monday on the south side of Adelaide Street West, between Charlotte Street and a point 50 metres west. 3. City Council rescind the existing commercial loading zone, in effect 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. on the south side of Adelaide Street West, between a point 54 metres east of Spadina Avenue and a point 28.5 metres west of Charlotte Street. 4.
